body.statement: Given a real algebraic number by an integer polynomial and rational isolating interval, the real roots of a univariate polynomial over its simple extension field can be isolated in bit time polynomial in the input degrees and coefficient bit lengths.

source.verbatim_statement: Using resultant computations, we perform a reduction to a polynomial with integer coefficients and isolate the real roots in \(\widetilde O_B(N^{10})\).

attestation.note: Transcribed from the abstract of Strzebonski and Tsigaridas, arXiv:1101.4369.
